units.source_text: 且说那左近少将等候八月佳期，颇不耐烦，央人来催促：

en.t: Now the Sakon Lesser Captain grew quite impatient while waiting for the auspicious day in the eighth month, and sent someone to press them:
Since you have already given your solemn promise, why not move the wedding date forward?

units.source_text: 要她一人独力提前准备，颇有困难之处；

en.t: For her to make all the preparations earlier by herself would be quite difficult;

units.source_text: 而对方人心究竟如何，也有些儿担心。

en.t: and she was also somewhat worried about what the other party truly felt.

units.source_text: 当初说合的媒人来到之时，她便请他进来，对他说道：

en.t: When the matchmaker who had first arranged the matter came, she invited him in and said to him:

units.source_text: “关于这女儿的婚事，可虑之处甚多。

en.t: There are many things to worry about concerning this daughter's marriage.

units.source_text: 以前蒙你作伐，我也考虑了很久。

en.t: When you kindly acted as go-between before, I thought about it for a long time.

units.source_text: 只因对方不是寻常之人，辱承青睐，未便违命，终于遵命订约。

en.t: Only because the other party was no ordinary person, and because we were honored by his favor, I could hardly refuse and finally agreed to the engagement as asked.

units.source_text: 但此女实系无父之儿，靠我一人抚育成人，

en.t: But this girl is truly a child without a father, raised to adulthood by me alone,

units.source_text: 深恐教养不周，受人非难，这是我早就担心的。

en.t: and I have long feared that if her upbringing proved lacking, people would criticize her.

units.source_text: 舍下原有许多青年女儿，但都有父亲照顾，

en.t: There are originally many young daughters in our household, but they all have fathers to look after them,

units.source_text: 自当听其做主，不须由我操心。

en.t: so naturally their fathers may decide for them, and I need not worry over them.

units.source_text: 只有这女儿，我深恐自己世寿无常，不免痛切关怀。

en.t: Only with this daughter, because I deeply fear the uncertainty of my own life, I cannot help caring for her with painful concern.

units.source_text: 久闻少将乃知情达理之人，

en.t: I have long heard that the Lesser Captain is a man of feeling and good sense,

units.source_text: 因此忘怀一切顾虑，将她许配。

en.t: and for that reason I set aside all my misgivings and promised her to him.

units.source_text: 但倘出乎意料之外，日后对方忽然变心，

en.t: But if, contrary to expectation, he should suddenly change his heart in the future,

units.source_text: 那时我们就成了世人的笑柄，真乃可悲之事了。”

en.t: then we would become a laughingstock to the world, and that would truly be a sorrowful thing.
